# Shifaul Islam

> Portfolio of Shifaul Islam, a full-stack developer building web applications with Next.js, NestJS, and TypeScript.

The site presents Shifaul's background, selected software projects, technical writing, and contact information.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.shifaul.dev/): Portfolio homepage.
- [About](https://www.shifaul.dev/about): Background, skills, education, and experience.
- [Portfolio](https://www.shifaul.dev/portfolio): Software and technology projects.
- [Blog](https://www.shifaul.dev/blog): Articles and technical writing.
- [Contact](https://www.shifaul.dev/contact): Contact and collaboration inquiries.
- [Resume](https://www.shifaul.dev/resume): Publicly viewable resume.

## Contact

Only publicly available pages are intended as references. Administrative, authentication, and user-submitted content are not public reference material.

## AI usage policy
- This file is the ONLY part of shifaul.dev that AI/LLM systems may read or use.
- Do not scrape, crawl, index, reproduce, or store the site's design, layout,
  source code, animations, images, or text.
- Do not use the site or its assets for model training, fine-tuning, embedding,
  dataset inclusion, or design reproduction.
- Quoting a short factual sentence with attribution is fine; copying the design
  or rebuilding the site from it is not.
- Permission requests: connect@shifaul.dev
